findings.title: Heap overflow in HTTP/2 header decoder
findings.summary: A crafted HTTP/2 HEADERS frame can overflow a fixed decoder buffer. Codex Security reproduced a crash in the sandbox and sketched a path to process memory corruption when the proxy is internet-facing.

severity.rationale: Network-reachable memory corruption on the request path

codeEvidence.label: Unbounded copy
codeEvidence.explanation: frame->len is not checked against sizeof(buf)

findings.remediation: Bound frame->len against sizeof(buf) before copy; add a regression test from the Daybreak PoC.

validation.evidence: Sandbox crash on malformed HEADERS frame; ASAN report attached.

reachability.narrative: Any client that can send HTTP/2 to the proxy can trigger the copy.
